_comment: Folder-role map for the Personal OS vault. Ships with the deployment, so a rename is a config change here rather than an edit scattered through the code. Roles not listed fall back to the standard vault layout (see vault_layout.DEFAULTS). Any role can also be overridden at runtime with VAULT_LAYOUT_<ROLE>, which wins over this file.
